THE SRI LANKA ARMED SERVICE LONG SERVICE MEDAL AND CLASP

It is hereby notified that His Excellency the President has been pleased to award the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal & Clasp to the persons specified in the schedule hereto. By His Excellency’s Command
Kamal Gunaratne, WWV, RWP, RSP, USP, ndc, psc MPhil General (Retd.), Secretary, Ministry of Defence.
